home.heroSubtitle: Where the earth meets organic luxury
home.introText:
Casa Judah is a family project born from the heart. We dreamed of it as a place where families and friends can reconnect, where children run free through the fields, and where every detail makes you feel at home.
More than a stay, we want to offer an authentic, simple space full of life, created to share moments that become unforgettable memories.
home.roomsText: Spaces designed for absolute rest. Natural textures, panoramic views, and a quietude found only far from the world.
home.experiencesText: Step into the rhythm of slow living. Animals, organic gardens, and a genuine connection to the land.
home.amenitiesText: Sun-drenched pool, private lounging areas, and spaces designed to elevate your serenity.
home.finalCtaText: Reserve your experience at Casa Judah and discover what it means to live with intention.

faqItems.q: Can I visit just to use the pool without staying overnight?
faqItems.a: Yes, we offer Day Passes subject to availability. We recommend contacting us via WhatsApp beforehand to reserve your spot.

faqItems.q: How far are you from downtown Catacamas?
faqItems.a: We are located approximately a 15-minute drive from downtown Catacamas, in a quiet and easily accessible countryside area.

home.locationText: Find us in the heart of Olancho, surrounded by nature and peace.

experiences.headerSubtitle: Reconnect with nature, embrace the slow pace, and indulge in genuine hospitality.
experiences.section1Text: At Casa Judah, we believe in the rhythm of the seasons. Join our bicycle rides, come feed our animals, and enjoy exciting ATV rides!
experiences.section2Text: Meet the residents of the farm. From our Sheep to the rabbits and calves, our animals are part of the Casa Judah family. Guests are welcome to participate in morning feedings.
experiences.section3Text: A cuisine born from the land itself. Every dish is crafted with local ingredients and time-honored recipes that celebrate the authentic flavors of Olancho — simple, honest, and deeply satisfying.

roomsPage.title: Our Accommodations
roomsPage.subtitle: Discover your perfect retreat. Each space is intentionally designed to harmonize with the surroundings.

policies.title: Casa Judah Policies
policies.subtitle: Please review our guidelines to ensure a peaceful stay for everyone.

sections.heading: Cancellation Policy
sections.intro: By making a reservation at Casa Judah, the guest accepts the following policies:

subsections.heading: Reservations
items: A deposit or full payment is required to confirm the reservation.
Dates are blocked immediately after payment.

subsections.heading: Cancellations
items: All payments made are non-refundable.
In case of cancellation, no refunds will be issued.

subsections.heading: Date Changes
items: A date change will only be allowed with a minimum of 15 days' notice and subject to availability.
Date changes may only be made once.

subsections.heading: No Shows
items: If the guest does not show up on the day of their reservation, the amount paid will be forfeited.

subsections.heading: Weather or Personal Situations
items: No refunds will be issued due to weather, illness, change of plans, traffic, flights, or other personal situations.

subsections.heading: Special Events and Groups
items: Reservations for events, birthdays, or large groups are 100% non-refundable.

sections.heading: Family & Relaxation Environment
sections.intro: Casa Judah is a space designed for rest, connection, and family time. Out of respect for all our guests, we ask that the following rules be observed:

subsections.heading: Quiet Hours
items: Please keep music and conversations at a moderate volume.
Quiet hours: 10:00 PM to 8:00 AM.

subsections.heading: Parties and Excess
items: Uncontrolled parties, excessive alcohol consumption, and disruptive behavior are not allowed.
Private events must be pre-authorized.

subsections.heading: Room Capacity
items: Only the number of registered guests per room is allowed.
External visitors are not permitted.

subsections.heading: Care of Facilities
items: Please take care of furniture, décor, and green areas.
Any damage caused will be the guest's responsibility.

subsections.heading: Children
items: Children must be accompanied by an adult in common areas and recreational zones.

subsections.heading: Pets
items: Pets are not allowed.

subsections.heading: Pool and Common Areas
items: Use at the guest's own risk.
No running or dangerous activities.

subsections.heading: Respect and Coexistence
items: Respect toward other guests and staff is expected.
We reserve the right of admission or continued stay in case of inappropriate behavior.
